title: 1801 Prairie's stone wall gable stands at its south-east corner
items: The Kimball house's south wall now rises at its rear corner into the steep coped stone gable that the 1965 survey photograph shows behind the rear chimney, with a pair of small windows at its foot just over the cornice.
Its height, outline and windows were matched to the photograph; its depth and the half the chimney hides are our reconstruction, and the cornice that should run on beneath it is still to come.
